svg.aria-label: The ecosystem in three groups: agent systems (ajans-os, turkce-ajanlar, mcp-vet), developer intelligence and AI infrastructure (claude-code-intelligence, ai-job-gateway, plus ai-workflow-engine, model-comparison-harness, prompt-template-manager, asset-provenance-toolkit), and products with local MCP tooling (buradane, nova-drift, plus mini-creative-toolkit, nvidia-nim-mcp, voice-io-mcp, local-notes-search-mcp). Every count is read out of the repo's own suite.
